dedupe_keys.name: industrial symbiosis and hydrogen system digital twin

description: The IS2H4C project team publishes a Streamlit digital-twin prototype for industrial hydrogen hubs. Zenodo archives version 1.1 under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and links a GitHub repository. The README describes renewable generation, battery charging, electrolyser schedules, seasonal hydrogen demand and storage, oxygen reuse and waste-heat flows. A mapped network view connects houses, a wastewater plant and hydrogen equipment; users can compare baseline, overproduction, grid-fallback and custom scenarios. This platform can test coupled energy and industrial-symbiosis assumptions in a teaching or exploratory simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is a prototype hub representation with bundled constants, not a verified operating industrial site. A limitation is that the README displays an MIT badge while GitHub exposes no recognised licence or licence file at the archived tag; the Zenodo archive licence is the supported statement for this draft. The app and model were not run, and its flow balances were not independently checked.
